remarks: "Buffalo's Waterfront at it's finest!  Spectacular waterfront living in the incomparable Rivermist community.  This All Brick, 3-bedroom, 3.5 bath, 3-level Townhouse offers breathtaking water, marina & Lake Erie views from the decks on each level and offers a combination of luxury & functionality.  The elegant, yet warm, Living room is light & bright & has a marble-faced gas fireplace; the main deck is off the beautiful formal Dining room which is perfect for entertaining & has new windows and door & recessed lighting. There are lovely provincial parquet floors throughout most of the 1st floor.  Welcome to a gourmet kitchen with beautiful candlelite color cabinetry, granite countertops & fully applianced with a Wolf gas stove for the chef in you and a breakfast/coffee bar.  You will love the private desk/office area and half bath to complete the 1st floor.  The lovely Primary bedroom on the 2nd level features ensuite bath with spacious double vanity, large glass shower, jacuzzi tub and a generous walk-in closet.  There is a guest bedroom with full bath as well as laundry with washer & dryer on the 2nd level.  The 3rd level is amazing and can be a 3rd bedroom with full bath or Family room as it is presently being used with wet bar.  Other amenities include attached garage, walk-in attic for storage, basement storage, central vac, central air & a new furnace (Aug. 2026), awning for the main deck and a lovely culdesac garden area to enjoy.  Rivermist is very convenient to the activities of Downtown Buffalo, it's Theater District & close proximity to our Medical Campus, thruways and more.  All this plus easy living while the HOA handles all exterior maintenance. Docks available. Pets allowed with approval.  Come enjoy the Rivermist views & lifestyle!"
